stories.text: 🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 41% / 17%, Mr. Action Jackson 86% / 65%.
⚡ Early edge: Claremont In Yo Stace! went from 22% to 38% against Kyle Tucker, led by Little (17.00 pts).
🧟 ZOMBIE STARTER: Tyler Loop was on injured reserve. Gibb it to Me Baby started him anyway. Inspiring commitment.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 45% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 14% with none (now 30%).
📈 LINE MOVE: NYG @ PHI: PHI −5.5 at open, NYG −3.5 now. 5 league starters in it, led by M. Nabers (Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy).
📈 LINE MOVE: HOU @ LAC: LAC −1.5 at open, HOU −6 now. 6 league starters in it, led by C. Stroud (Ramosverse).
🎟️ RAFFLE WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane (33% to take the ticket) is chasing Kirbo Crushers' 28.08 — 28.08 pts back with 10 starters still to play.
🗓️ Sunday's key matchup: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 50% vs 49er Faith-Fool. Watch McCaffrey (22.24 pts) vs Taylor (19.95 pts).
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 42%, with Uriel's Upbeat Team next at 34%.
🎯 10 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Mr. Action Jackson right on the line (49%).
📈 TRENDING: Every other league is scrambling for Carson Wentz (QB, MIN). Ours has him sitting on waivers.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Claremont In Yo Stace! added Kendre Miller (RB, projected 9.52 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 11% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted The Mahomies after the favorite flipped 5 times.
